title: Merge Triplets to Form Target Triplet
kidExplanation: Story version: We can solve this problem by iterating through the triplets and checking if each triplet can contribute to forming the target triplet. The idea is to keep track of the maximum values encountered for each element in the triplet. At the end, if the maximum values for each element are greater than or equal to the corresponding values in the target triplet, then it's possible to form the target triplet.
